description: This file defines an Android Activity named AudioFxDemo that demonstrates the use of audio effects such as Visualizer and Equalizer on an audio playback. It initializes a MediaPlayer with a resource, sets up visualizer and equalizer UI controls, and manages their lifecycle.

classes.name: AudioFxDemo
classes.description: An Activity that demonstrates audio visualization and equalizer controls using MediaPlayer, Visualizer, and Equalizer.

classes.name: VisualizerView
classes.description: A custom View that renders a visualization of the audio waveform data captured from Visualizer.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI, media playback, visualizer, and equalizer.

methods.name: setupEqualizerFxAndUI
methods.description: Configures the equalizer UI controls adjusting audio bands.

methods.name: setupVisualizerFxAndUI
methods.description: Initializes the Visualizer for capturing waveform data and rendering it.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Releases the visualizer, equalizer, and media player resources when activity pauses.
